**[P2] Contain type inspection during rejection notification**

`_factory_type()` calls `isinstance(factory, type)`, which can execute an instance's `__class__` descriptor. If an explicit factory has a callable `create_plugin` but a `__class__` property that raises `RuntimeError`, validation enters rejection cleanup and this unguarded lookup raises again. Any resource-owning factory later in the list never receives `on_registration_result(False)`. Use descriptor-free class detection or include the owner lookup in the per-factory exception guard so notification continues, and cover this case in the mixed-list cleanup tests.
